6752853.reason: Greedily chooses the adjacent swap with greatest immediate numeric gain, instead of allocating swaps to bring the largest reachable digit to the next prefix position. On 1234 with 3 swaps it builds 3214, while moving 4 to the front yields the achievable optimum 4123.

6755856.reason: The condition 'if j-i: continue' skips every desired digit at any later position, irrespective of available k, so no nontrivial swap can occur. It leaves 1990 unchanged with k=1 instead of moving the first 9 one place left to obtain 9190.

6756206.reason: Consumes the swap budget in left-to-right insertion-sort order rather than choosing the best achievable prefix. For 1234,k=3 it spends all swaps on early smaller digits and returns 3214 instead of bringing 4 to the front for 4123.

6794843.reason: Chooses the rightmost occurrence of an equal maximum reachable digit, wasting swaps compared with the nearest equal maximum. For 9022,k=2 it spends both swaps moving the last 2 and obtains 9202; moving the nearer 2 leaves one swap to obtain 9220.

6816804.reason: Checks t<k only outside an inner loop which can perform multiple swaps, so that loop overspends the allowed budget. For 9090000078001234,k=6 it emits 9970000008001234, whose independently computed minimum adjacent-swap distance is 7. The legal optimum with 6 swaps is 9907000008001234.
